description: Update a key result's current progress and/or definition — set the latest value, add a note, or rename it. Only the provided fields change. Returns the updated key result.

key_result_id.description: ID of the key result to update.

name.description: New name for the key result. Omit to keep current.

note.description: Optional note describing this progress update.

steps_current.description: The latest measured value, used to compute progress toward the target.

name: update_key_result
